literature_claim_statement: Digital Twin technology is an established paradigm for predictive maintenance and condition monitoring across Industry 4.0 and civil infrastructure.
source_title: A Survey on AI-Driven Digital Twins in Industry 4.0: Smart Manufacturing and Advanced Robotics
notes_and_context: Supported additionally by Hasan & Crawford (2025, Digital Twin), Pathri & Ganduri (2025), and Wei (2024 NTU thesis). Proves DT + PdM is not a novel concept.

literature_claim_statement: Point estimation of Remaining Useful Life using machine learning and deep learning is mature and heavily published.
source_title: Damage Propagation Modeling for Aircraft Engine Run-to-Failure Simulation
notes_and_context: C-MAPSS benchmark was formulated in 2008. Point prediction alone has zero novelty.

claim_topic: Digital Twin integrated with RUL prediction
literature_claim_statement: Coupling a Digital Twin platform with machine learning RUL estimation has been demonstrated using laboratory battery degradation telemetry.
source_title: Research on Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Equipment Based on Digital Twins
notes_and_context: Wu et al. (2026) implement a Digital Twin maintenance-support platform for battery RUL prediction using CS2_35 battery lab data. Uncertainty limits are identified as future work.

literature_claim_statement: Prognostic models generating prediction intervals or probabilistic distributions rather than deterministic point estimates are documented in reliability literature.
source_title: Predictive Maintenance Strategies for Aero-Engines Considering Remaining Useful Life Prediction Interval
exact_citation_location: Quality and Reliability Engineering International 2025, DOI: 10.1002/qre.70043
notes_and_context: Supported by Zhu et al. (2025) publisher abstract describing deep-learning/Monte Carlo dropout prediction intervals, Walia & Kumar (2026) quantile regression with CNN/GRU, and Chen et al. (2022).

claim_topic: RUL uncertainty connected to maintenance decisions
literature_claim_statement: Integrating RUL prediction intervals into predictive maintenance decisions and cost optimization models has been formulated in aero-engine and IIoT literature.
source_title: Uncertainty-aware remaining useful life prediction and PPO based optimal maintenance scheduling in industrial IoT
notes_and_context: Walia & Kumar (2026) describe PPO reinforcement learning maintenance scheduling, Zhu et al. (2025) describe maintenance-cost optimization using prediction intervals, and Chen et al. (2022) consider uncertainty in predictive maintenance.

claim_topic: Conformal calibration applied to RUL prediction
literature_claim_statement: Conformal prediction methods have been applied to neural networks and gradient boosting models on turbofan RUL benchmarks to provide prediction interval validity under exchangeability assumptions.
source_title: Conformal Prediction Intervals for Remaining Useful Lifetime Estimation
notes_and_context: Javanmardi & Hüllermeier (2023), Diao et al. (2026), and Robinson (2026) applied conformal prediction to C-MAPSS, achieving prediction interval coverage subject to exchangeability assumptions.

claim_topic: Stage-wise and cross-condition interval analysis in turbofan prognostics
literature_claim_statement: Life-stage analysis and cross-condition evaluation with labeled target adaptation have been demonstrated in turbofan prediction interval calibration.
source_title: Turbofan Engine Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Reliable Prediction Intervals via LSTM-Based Quantile Regression and Conformal Calibration
notes_and_context: Diao et al. (2026) evaluate LSTM quantile regression with conformal calibration/CQR across C-MAPSS FD001 and FD002, conducting life-stage analysis and cross-condition evaluation with labeled target adaptation.

claim_topic: Operating-regime conditional reliability studied in rotating machinery
literature_claim_statement: Operating-regime conditional-reliability diagnostics demonstrate that marginal calibration does not guarantee uniform conditional coverage across regime shifts in bearing testbeds.
source_title: Empirical Calibration and Conditional-Reliability Diagnostics for Bearing RUL Prediction under Operating-Regime Shift
notes_and_context: Yang et al. (2026) evaluate operating-regime conditional-reliability diagnostics on a ten-bearing PHME subset using empirical residual calibration and post-hoc regime-conditioned diagnostics, alongside retrospective maintenance-trigger comparisons.

claim_topic: Research gap on conditional calibration and maintenance decisions
literature_claim_statement: Prior work already includes conformal RUL prediction, life-stage and operating-regime diagnostics, and maintenance-related evaluation. IntelliTwin’s research gap is under reassessment following corrections to the closest-work comparison.
source_title: Turbofan Engine Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Reliable Prediction Intervals via LSTM-Based Quantile Regression and Conformal Calibration
notes_and_context: Evidence status: Under reassessment. Prior work already includes conformal RUL prediction, life-stage/operating-regime diagnostics, and maintenance evaluation. A possible next direction is a controlled replication and extension examining sequential decisions, information availability, and replacement conservatism; its originality is not yet established.
